info.name: Fertis Website API
info.description:
Every API the Fertis website needs to show its home banner, products and crops from the admin data. All requests are public `GET` requests: no token, no headers.

## Setup
- `base_url` = backend URL + `/api/v1`, for example `http://localhost:5200/api/v1`. Import `backend/postman/environments/Local.postman_environment.json`, or edit the collection variable.
- `asset_url` = backend URL without `/api/v1` (for example `http://localhost:5200`). Image and PDF fields are paths like `/uploads/crops/seed-maize.jpg`; the website must put `asset_url` in front of them.
- The backend allows browser calls from the origins in `CORS_ORIGIN` in `backend/.env` (`*` = any). On a live server, set it to the website domain, e.g. `https://fertis-web.testlegal.com`.

## Response shape
Success: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": ... }`
Error: `{ "success": false, "message": "...", ... }` with status `400` (bad query, see message) or `404` (unknown or inactive slug).
Paged lists: `data = { rows: [...], totalItems, totalPages, currentPage }`.

## Which page calls what
| Website page | Requests |
|---|---|
| Header / menus | Categories |
| Home (`/`) | Home banner (with the visitor's state), States (if the site lets visitors pick a state) |
| Products (`/products`) | Categories (tabs), Brands + Applications + Crops (filter checkboxes), Product list |
| Product page (`/products/:slug`) | Product detail |
| Crops (`/crops`) | Crop Types (tabs), Crops (sidebar checkboxes), Crop gallery |
| Crop schedule page (`/crops/:slug`) | Crop detail |

Only active rows are returned everywhere. Turning something off in the admin hides it from the website at once.

Each request has saved example responses (taken from the seeded development data), so you can see the fields without sending anything.

query.description: The visitor's state slug (from States). Left out, empty, unknown or without its own video = the default video. The website decides how it learns the state.

request.description:
The hero at the top of the home page. Never returns `404`.

- `title`: the headline lines (1 to 3, empty lines left out). Show each on its own line.
- `highlight`: a phrase inside one of the lines to show in gold (`#E9C03C`), or `null`. Show ordinal suffixes like "st" as superscript, as today.
- `buttons`: 1 or 2 `{ label, link, style }`. `style` is `primary` (solid navy) or `secondary` (white outline). `link` is a site path like `/solutions` or a full URL.
- `state`: the state slug whose own video was used, or `null` when the default video was used.
- `video`: `{ poster, duration, sources }`, or `null` only if not even the default video has finished converting (show the poster/gradient only).
- `sources`: light MP4 versions, lightest first: `low` (360p, about 250 KB for 8 s), `medium` (540p), `high` (720p). A small video may not have all three. Each has `src`, `width`, `height` and `size` in bytes. No sound track.

**Suggested playback (the website team decides):**
- Render `<video muted playsinline loop autoplay poster="...">` and show the poster first.
- Pick the source by `navigator.connection.effectiveType` where supported: `slow-2g` or `saveData` = poster only; `2g` = `low`; `3g` = `medium`; otherwise `high`.
- Where the browser does not report the connection (Safari): `medium` up to 768 px wide, otherwise `high`.
- `poster` and `src` are `/uploads/...` paths: put `asset_url` in front.

response.name: 200 State with its own video
200 Default video (state without its own video)
200 No state sent

query.description: One category slug (from Categories). Empty or left out = all categories.
Comma-separated brand slugs (from Brands), e.g. `dormulin,zetol`. Matches any of them.
Comma-separated application slugs (from Applications), e.g. `drip,organic`. Matches any of them.
Comma-separated crop slugs (from Crops), e.g. `paddy,cotton`. Matches any of them.

request.description:
The Products page grid: active products as cards, 12 per page.

Filters take slugs. Values inside one filter match any of them; different filters must all match (for example `category=fungicides&crops=paddy,cotton` = fungicides used on paddy **or** cotton).
Unknown slugs return an empty list, not an error. `limit` above 48 returns `400`.

`data` = `{ rows, totalItems, totalPages, currentPage }`.

response.name: 200 One category, first 2 cards
200 Brand + crop filters
400 limit too high

variable.description: Product slug, from a product card `slug`.

request.description:
The product page (`/products/:slug` on the website).

- Hero: `headline` and `body`. `body` is cleaned HTML (paragraphs, bold, italic, underline, lists, links), so it can be rendered as HTML.
- Sections: `benefits` (Key Benefits), `recommended_crops` (Recommended Crops), `application` (Application rows).
- `image` and `pdf` are paths (`pdf` can be `null`); put `asset_url` in front.
- `other_products`: 4 other product cards for the bottom of the page.
- Empty detail fields already fall back to the tagline, description and filter crops, like the live site.
Inactive or unknown slugs return `404`.

response.name: 200 OK
404 Unknown slug

query.description: One crop type slug (from Crop Types) = one tab. Empty or left out = every crop that has at least one active type.
Comma-separated crop slugs (from Crops) for the sidebar checkboxes, e.g. `paddy,cotton`.

request.description:
The Crops page grid (`/crops` on the website): active crops as cards, 9 per page, in Crop master order.

A crop only shows here when it has at least one active crop type; crops without a type still have a detail page.

`data` = `{ rows, totalItems, totalPages, currentPage }`. Each card has `types` for tags.

response.name: 200 One tab (Plantation Crops)
200 All tabs, sidebar crops

variable.description: Crop slug, from a gallery card `slug`.

request.description:
The crop schedule page (`/crops/:slug` on the website).

- `stages`: the 6 fixed stages (key, name) for the stage tabs, always in this order.
- `schedules`: one per active method (Drip, Non Drip, Organic...), in Application master order. An empty array means no schedule yet.
- Each schedule lists all 6 stages. A stage with `rows: []` should show "Schedule for this stage will be updated soon."
- Each row: `time`, `product { name, slug }`, `applications`, `dose`, `quantity`. `product.name` is the label set in the admin, or the product name. `product.slug` is `null` when the product is inactive, so show the name without a link. `dose` can be `null` or empty.

Inactive or unknown crops return `404`.

response.name: 200 With a schedule
200 No schedule yet
404 Unknown crop
